cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: An offline advisory model for Togolese smallholder farmers and extension officers. It gives practical crop, livestock, weather and market guidance grounded in Togo's national services (ICAT, ITRA, ANAMET, ANSAT, CAGIA, SIM), so it works in rural areas with no internet.

training_datasets: agritgllm-gate2-sft (chain K): provenance/data/sft_train.jsonl, 7,987 conversations written from Togolese extension sheets (ICAT, ITRA, ANAMET, ANSAT, CAGIA, SIM), sha256 in provenance/checksums.txt
agritgllm-gate2-dpo (chain K): provenance/data/dpo_train.jsonl, 2,817 preference pairs from the same sheets, sha256 in provenance/checksums.txt
agritgllm-gate2-sft-o (chain O): provenance/data_o/sft_train.jsonl, 8,146 conversations, the same sheets plus 69 hand-written exchanges on exposure and refusals, sha256 in provenance/checksums.txt

test_prompts.prompt: Who are you, and what can you help me with?
Is a small local-hen unit profitable in the first year in Togo?

recommended_sampling._note: Liquid AI's recommendation for the LFM2 family. All figures in REPORT.md section 5 were measured with these values on the target machine.
